parameters.subject: ={{ $json.total_incidents > 0 ? '🚨 安全インシデント報告 - ' + $json.total_incidents + '件の処理待ち' : '✅ 安全インシデント報告 - 処理待ちのインシデントなし' }}

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    i.*,
    '{{ $json.email }}' AS email_manager,
    '{{ $json.name }}' AS name_manager,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE company_id = {{ $json.company_id }} AND status = 'pending') AS total_incidents,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE company_id = {{ $json.company_id }} AND status = 'pending' AND severity = 'critical') AS critical_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE company_id = {{ $json.company_id }} AND status = 'pending' AND severity = 'high') AS high_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE company_id = {{ $json.company_id }} AND status = 'pending' AND severity = 'medium') AS medium_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE company_id = {{ $json.company_id }} AND status = 'pending' AND severity = 'low') AS low_count
FROM `incidents` i 
WHERE i.company_id = {{ $json.company_id }} AND i.status = 'pending'
ORDER BY 
    CASE i.severity 
        WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 
        WHEN 'high' THEN 2 
        WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 
        WHEN 'low' THEN 4 
    END,
    i.created_at ASC;
